title: Public records appear to show SpaceX building a "Starbase supercomputer" in TX, but Gina Hinojosa's election as governor may delay some of the data center plans (Ann Davis Vaughan/The Information)
summary: Ann Davis Vaughan / The Information: Public records appear to show SpaceX building a “Starbase supercomputer” in TX, but Gina Hinojosa's election as governor may delay some of the data center plans — Elon Musk moved early to build AI data centers in Tennessee and Mississippi and reaped the rewards.
